note: Held-out cases: written after the sanitiser rules were developed on cases.json and committed before any model was run on them. Do not tune the sanitiser on these.

cases.description: Glycerine with a kinematic viscosity of 1.2e-3 m²/s is pumped at 0.2 m/s through a 3 cm diameter pipe.
A 30 cm diameter chimney stands in a 2-D cross-wind of 8 m/s (air).
Unsteady wake behind a 5 mm diameter wire placed across a water flow of 2 cm/s.
Air at 200 m/s and 300 K flows through a straight 2-D duct 5 cm high.
Water creeps at 5 mm/s through a microchannel 0.5 mm high.
Buoyancy-driven air circulation in a closed 2-D room 3 m square, with one wall at 30 °C and the opposite wall at 15 °C.
Water at 0.3 m/s passes over a backward-facing step 1 cm high in a channel 2 cm high.
Steady wind of 5 m/s past a rectangular block 2 m wide and 2 m high standing on open ground (2-D).
A wing section with a 0.2 m chord in air at 15 m/s.
Water held behind a gate in a tank is suddenly released and floods the dry side of the tank under gravity.
